subject: Renewal: add isolated analytics enclave + 24-month term — Acme Health
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Renewal inquiry + isolated analytics enclave

Hi Ava,

We are approaching our contract renewal window and want to discuss adding a separate, isolated analytics enclave for Acme Health's BI workloads. Current asks from infra & security: add two additional clusters (dedicated to analytics, strict VPC isolation), extend the term to 24 months, and preserve the current data residency (us-east-1).

High-level constraints:
- Analytics cluster will run heavy embedding/semantic search jobs — expected sustained QPS ~120 requests/sec, spikes to ~350 for short windows.
- Must be logically isolated from our production model serving; network allowed only from our VPN endpoints/IP ranges.
- Need SOC2 evidence and confirmation of KMS integration for customer-managed keys.

Procurement timeline: we need a PO on or before 2027-03-25 to match our internal fiscal timing. Can you send a renewal quote + any compliance artifacts?

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel
Head of Infrastructure | Acme Health
Sanjay.Patel@acmehealth.com

2) Marissa will share a pricing supplement and a MAP (mutual action plan) with dates for signature and provisioning.
3) Priyom will confirm lead times and the security artifacts (SOC2, KMS details, network diagram).

Prelim attachment: ACME_renewal_quote_v1.pdf (pricing stub) — this includes two cluster SKUs and a 24-mo term option. Pricing is draft until we confirm region and final throughput profile.

- Preferred region (you mentioned us-east-1 — confirm)

Thanks team — a few clarifications from security & procurement:

- Throughput: the 120 sustained QPS is per analytics cluster, total combined peak expected ~700 QPS. Can you confirm that the two clusters (plus optional DR cluster) will handle that with the SKU sizing in the quote?

Appreciate you moving fast on this.
